In addition, this derailment [[Page 26726]] caused extensive damage to the town center, clean-up costs, and the evacuation of approximately 2,000 people from the surrounding area. Although this regulatory action would not prevent such accidents involving unattended trains, the Lac-Megantic incident demonstrates that very large economic losses occur with catastrophic derailments.
